s.note: Hallorann's tour of the giant pantry
s.how: Warm 250g mixed olives in 60ml olive oil with strips of orange peel, 1 sliced garlic clove and chilli flakes for 5 minutes, then cool. Slice 150g salami and 150g provolone. Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, 200g giardiniera pickled vegetables, 100g marinated artichokes, 1 packet grissini and a handful of cornichons. Serve at room temperature.

Toss 400g mixed unsalted nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tsp salt flakes and a pinch of cayenne. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant. Cool for 5 minutes so the coating sets, then serve warm in small bowls.

m.note: the walk-in freezer tour, Dick knows every shelf
m.how: Stud a 2kg leg of lamb with 4 sliced garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs, rub with oil, salt and pepper. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 20 minutes with 1kg quartered potatoes around it. Rest 15 minutes and make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.

w.note: he asks Danny if he likes chocolate ice cream
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with 150g dark chocolate and 2 tbsp cocoa. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook, stirring, to 82C. Chill overnight and churn, or freeze and stir every 30 minutes.

d.note: Jack's order from Lloyd at the Gold Room
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds. Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block. Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in. Totals are 240ml bourbon, 40ml syrup and 1 orange.
